title: Complementary Fourier levels of majority
statement: Let $n$ be an odd natural number, and let $k$ be a natural number with $1\le k\le n$. For majority on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, the Fourier weight at level $n-k+1$ equals $\frac{k}{n-k+1}$ times the Fourier weight at level $k$.
